description: "The shared SingleCollector block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library (Claude

  tables. 2 owned fields over 0 schema paths.\n\nGENERATED by tools/build_module_bb.py

$defs:
  Param_Procedure_detectorConfiguration:
    title: Detector Configuration
    description: 'Type(s) of detector(s) installed in the mass spectrometer and the
      detection mode(s) used: pulse counting, analog and, on some sector-field instruments,
      Faraday. The cross-calibration between detector modes is recorded in Pulse/Analog
      Detector Nonlinearity Correction (Group 5).'
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:parameter/module/SingleCollector/detectorConfiguration
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: detectorConfiguration
      schema:name:
        const: Detector Configuration
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      ada:fieldScope:
        const: session
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: true
      ada:tier:
        const: R
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - ada:fieldScope
  Param_Analysis_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrection:
    title: Pulse Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
    description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response
      at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode
      instruments) detection modes. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes
      must be confirmed, typically measured each session. Record 'Applied' and describe
      the method, the detector modes involved and the target species affected; 'None'
      where a crossover exists on this instrument but no correction was made, giving
      the reason; and 'N/A' where the detector is pulse-counting only and no crossover
      exists.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:parameter/module/SingleCollector/pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrection
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValue
      schema:propertyID:
        const:
        - '@id': ada:parameter/module/SingleCollector/pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrection
      schema:name:
        const: Pulse Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
      schema:value:
        type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:propertyID
    - schema:name
    - schema:value
  Param_Procedure_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrection:
    title: Pulse Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
    description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response
      at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode
      instruments) detection modes. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes
      must be confirmed, typically measured each session. Record 'Applied' and describe
      the method, the detector modes involved and the target species affected; 'None'
      where a crossover exists on this instrument but no correction was made, giving
      the reason; and 'N/A' where the detector is pulse-counting only and no crossover
      exists.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:parameter/module/SingleCollector/pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrectionDefault
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: pulseAnalogDetectorNonlinearityCorrectionDefault
      schema:name:
        const: Pulse Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      ada:fieldScope:
        const: session
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: R
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - ada:fieldScope
